title: Prematurely
summary: PREMATU'RELY, adverb Too soon; too early; before the proper time; as fruits prematurely ripened; opinions prematurely formed; measures prematurely taken. 1. Without due evidence or authentication; as

inlines.v: PREMATU'RELY, adverb Too soon; too early; before the proper time; as fruits prematurely ripened; opinions prematurely formed; measures prematurely taken. 1. Without due evidence or authentication; as intelligence prematurely received.
